title: Optimize-prompt config (mpi-optimize-prompt)
description: Prompt optimizer settings. Unknown keys and invalid values are ignored at load time.

model.description: `provider/modelId` used for optimization; omit or "inherit" = active session model.

thinking.description: Thinking level for optimization; omit or "inherit" = active session thinking.

systemPrompt.description: Full metaprompt override; omit = built-in default.
